يغتفرون (form VIII)
# يَغْتَفِرُونَ (yaḡtafirūna) /jaɣ.ta.fi.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# يُغْتَفَرُونَ (yuḡtafarūna) /juɣ.ta.fa.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
